trends.name: Iran Nuclear Deal & Ceasefire Negotiations
trends.summary: US proposing 15-point plan to end Iran conflict with one-month ceasefire framework via Witkoff/Kushner. Iran vows to never seek nuclear weapons; negotiations include uranium delivery to IAEA and decommissioning demands. Real-time tension: US simultaneously preparing military escalation options if talks fail, creating binary risk outlook for markets.

trends.name: Oil Market Volatility & Energy Risk Premium
trends.summary: Oil oscillating sharply on Iran deal signals—down 5%+ on talks optimism, up on Strait of Hormuz blockade threats. Treasury auction weakness and bond yield spikes reflect investor anxiety over energy supply disruption. Selective Hormuz strategy poses material commodity shock risk if negotiations collapse.

trends.name: Fed Rate Hike Unlikely Despite Market Pricing
trends.summary: While markets price 30% odds of rate increase by October, Fed policy likely remains on hold. Softer labor market shaped by AI adoption and geopolitical risks keep hiking pressure minimal. Gold jumps 2%+ as inflation fears ease, reinforcing dovish bias.

trends.name: Electrical Grid Capacity Crisis & Blackout Risk
trends.summary: US electrical grid facing surging demand-driven blackout risk, particularly in NYC. AI data center buildout and infrastructure strain creating $2T rebuild opportunity over 5-10 years. Major investment theme for grid modernization and power generation companies.

trends.name: Meta's AI Talent Retention & Regulatory Pressure
trends.summary: Meta making 'big bet' on top leaders with expanded stock options to compete in AI race while facing $375M penalty for child exploitation violations in New Mexico. Dual narrative: aggressive AI investment vs. regulatory/compliance headwinds pressuring profitability.

trends.name: AI Chip Demand & Memory Market Surge
trends.summary: SK Hynix filing confidentially for US listing amid 'unprecedented growth' in memory market driven by AI demand. Arm stock pops 6% on CEO's $15B revenue expectation for new chips. Semiconductor sector benefiting from AI infrastructure buildout.

trends.name: Software Stocks & AI Disruption Fear
trends.summary: Software sector experiencing whipsaw: initially seen thriving on AI, then selling off as AI displacement fears resurface. Uncertainty over which software categories benefit vs. face obsolescence driving volatility and sector rotation.

trends.name: OpenAI Restructuring & Sora Platform Pivot
trends.summary: OpenAI CEO shifting responsibilities and planning to discontinue Sora video platform app while prepping 'Spud' AI model. Strategic repositioning amid AI competitive pressure signals changing product priorities at key player.

trends.name: DOD/Anthropic Antitrust & AI Policy Uncertainty
trends.summary: Judge pressing DOD on why Anthropic was blacklisted from contracts, questioning low bar for exclusion. Signals regulatory uncertainty around AI company partnerships and federal procurement policy affecting AI sector valuations.

trends.name: Crypto & Blockchain Market Integration
trends.summary: Securitize becomes NYSE's first digital transfer agent, enabling stock/ETF share creation as blockchain tokens. Bitcoin erased Monday gains but infrastructure development continues—major shift toward tokenized securities and market structure evolution.

trends.name: Banking Regulatory Risk & Consumer Trust
trends.summary: Elizabeth Warren raises concerns over MrBeast's teen banking app and its connection to troubled bank, signaling regulatory spotlight on fintech partnerships. Swiss bank Edmond de Rothschild searched in Epstein-connected diplomat investigation—compliance risks for financial institutions.

trends.name: Real Estate & Housing Market Indicators
trends.summary: KB Home Q1 2026 earnings and municipal bond fund commentary reflect mixed housing signals. CoreWeave capex backlog and real estate sector valuations showing uneven recovery amid economic uncertainty and rate pressure.
